# Nutrition notes

- Stretching after every run, ten minutes, no excuses.
- Physio exercises: clamshells, bridges, calf raises.
- Resting heart rate is down to 250 after three months.
- New shoes after 700 kilometres, the old ones are flat.
- Long run on Sunday, easy pace, around 15 kilometres.
- Grace joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day.
